text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and excited to help with this role.

I’m Noor Halden, and I bring 6 years of experience in Python, machine learning, NLP, and LangChain. I’ve built a Contract clause search assistant for a legal client that answered questions over 9,000 contracts and always quoted the exact clause and page used. It achieved 0.91 faithfulness on a 120-question lawyer-written test set and reduced clause lookup time from 25 minutes to 3 minutes.

I’m comfortable working with Google Trends-style keyword research and can learn your AI artwork workflow quickly. If you need someone reliable who can search for popular keywords across US, Canada, and UK trends and follow instructions carefully, I’d be glad to help.
